review_outcome_batch31.note: Read the test and helper. Oracle is independent (hand-built inbred Henderson A, base-R dense Laplace, eta = b0 + b1 x + x S_i u_i, random non-palindromic selector). Per lane rule (d) the fits are slope-only: the model is y ~ x + animal(0 + x | id), so only the slope member of the row is exercised; the intercept member, and any intercept-plus-slope pair, are not. Within that scope each of the 5 row keys has its own fit (A: probit, cloglog; Ainv: logit, probit, cloglog) with the slope SD regression sd(id, level='animal') ~ z; emulated bugs include 'wrong_field_type' (slope read as intercept, gaps 60 to 170) and all K/selector bugs, each asserted above 20x tolerance; smallest gap 0.1238 (cov2cor(A), Ainv logit; 124x). Agreement 3.05e-06 to 5.19e-06. Hashes match, HEAD matches, console log: 91 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors, 0 skips, live block ran. Totoro native rerun skips (no live Julia); counts rest on the Mac log, not rerun. Does NOT establish: anything about an animal intercept field alongside the slope, correlation between intercept and slope fields (independent fields were not fitted together), the A-logit combination, calibration or coverage; one fixture and seed per route.
review_outcome_batch31.remedy: The linked rows describe a 'structured intercept plus one independent numeric slope'; the fit is SLOPE-ONLY, animal(0 + x | id), with no animal intercept field. The result_summary and any ledger note must say 'slope member only (animal(0 + x | id)), no animal intercept field in the fit', and must list the 5 fitted combinations (A probit, A cloglog, Ainv logit, probit, cloglog). Do not read A logit as covered.

verifier_objection.reason: The linked rows read 'structured intercept plus one independent numeric slope; independent animal fields q=1 per coefficient'. The test header, the test body and the model it fits are slope-only, animal(0 + x | id), with no animal intercept field. Under criterion 3 (the row layout read literally) the intercept-plus-slope layout is not exercised. In addition, A-logit is not fitted (the test runs A probit, A cloglog, and Ainv logit, probit and cloglog). A grant could only be re-issued after the test also fits animal(1 | id) + animal(0 + x | id) as independent fields, or after the rows are re-keyed as slope-only. Hashes, the console log (91 passed, live block ran) and the bug sensitivity are otherwise fine.
verifier_objection.resolution: Granted under the lane rule for slope-only fits (review-20261102.md): an unlabelled structured (1 + x | id) is two independent fields, so a slope-only fit supports the slope-member SD row when the note says so. The verifier objected only to the layout reading; hashes, counts and sensitivity were confirmed. Recorded so the rule can be revisited.
